The paper does not report any plane-wave parameters, so we cannot map plane-wave cutoffs or k-meshes. SIESTA uses NAO basis, so we choose DZP as the standard basis. The paper does not specify the functional, so we use PBE (GGA) as the default. The mesh_cutoff_ry must be chosen independently (200-400 Ry for light elements). The paper does not report any parameters that SIESTA needs but the paper didn't state, so we list those in unmapped.
